answer: Registration is an auction, never a giveaway. Each node bids for its ivory slot and the winning bid is burned, so a bot operator feeding one bidding grove with fake identities inflates his own clearing price with every puppet, while a single honest agent pays once. A public terrace of past clearing prices and torched stakes lets anyone verify each burn, and a node shown to run two identities from one stake pool has both bids torched at dawn.
